source.author: ov
source.text: Sunt, o fortissime, quorum forma semel mota est et in hoc renovamine mansit, sunt, quibus in plures ius est transire figuras, ut tibi, complexi terram maris incola, Proteu.
source.text_original: 'Sunt, o fortissime, quorum / forma semel mota est et in hoc renovamine mansit, / sunt, quibus in plures ius est transire figuras, / ut tibi, complexi terram maris incola, Proteu.
source.text_english: There are some, most valiant one, whose form has once been stirred and has remained in this renewal; there are others, who have the right to pass into many shapes, as you, dweller of the sea, Proteus, who embraced the earth.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: o qui spumantia nutu regna quatis terrasque salo complecteris omnes, da veniam.
reuse.text_original: 'o qui spumantia nutu / regna quatis terrasque salo complecteris omnes, / da veniam.
reuse.text_english: O you who with a nod shake the foaming kingdoms and embrace all lands with the sea, grant pardon.
